rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sequence of musical notes forming a tune.

example.english: The melody of this song is beautiful, and I remembered it after one listen.
example.traditional: 呢首歌嘅旋律好優美，我聽咗一次就記得。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 ge3 syun4 leot2 hou2 jau1 mei5 ngo5 teng1 zo2 jat1 ci3 zau6 gei3 dak1

rows.note: Use this casual choice when referring specifically to the tune or musical line of a song, often in phrases such as “the song’s tune.”

example.english: The melody of this song is so catchy that everyone knows how to sing it.
example.traditional: 呢首歌嘅調咁易記，難怪個個都識唱。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 diu6 gam3 ji6 gei3 naan4 gwaai3 go3 go3 dou1 sik1 coeng3
